title: On Leonardo da Vinci's paradox
summary: Buoyancy points straight upward, yet in the absence of external forces, a rising air bubble may trace a spiral through the water. This phenomenon was already observed by Leonardo da Vinci. We show that the gravity-free, three-dimensional two-phase incompressible Euler equations with surface tension already admit such a motion. For every nonnegative inner-to-outer density ratio and every sufficiently small positive axial Weber number, we construct smooth near-spherical bubbles and drops with compact interfaces and phasewise irrotational flow.
